name: 5-MeO-MALT
summary: A new and uncommon psychedelic tryptamine related to 5-MeO-DALT. Little is known about the drug, however its effects are likely similar to other psychedelic tryptamines.
advisory: There are inconsistent reports on the drugs effects. It is recommended to start low and raise dosages slowly.
doseBasis: NOTE: There are inconsistent reports on the drugs effects. It is recommended to start low and raise dosages slowly.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet

pharmacology.text: The pharmacology of 5-MeO-MALT has been studied. It is a potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and produces the head-twitch response in rodents. The drug also shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2014. The drug's pharmacology was studied and described in greater detail in 2024.

summaryZh: 5-MeO-MALT（5-甲氧基-N-甲基-N-烯丙基色胺）是一種較為少見的致幻藥物，與5-MeO-DALT相似，在網絡上以狡詐家藥物出售。它在匈牙利屬於非法藥品；瑞典公共衛生機構在2019年5月15日提出將其列為有害物質。
summaryZhHans: 5-MeO-MALT（5-甲氧基-N-甲基-N-烯丙基色胺）是一种较为少见的致幻药物，与5-MeO-DALT相似，在网络上以狡诈家药物出售。它在匈牙利属于非法药品；瑞典公共卫生机构在2019年5月15日提出将其列为有害物质。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is 5-MeO-DALT with one of its two allyl chains shortened to a methyl group, so it has one garlic-derived allyl group instead of two.
fact.zh: 它是把5-MeO-DALT兩條烯丙基鏈中的一條縮短為甲基，因此只剩一個源自大蒜命名的烯丙基，而不是兩個。
fact.zhHans: 它是把5-MeO-DALT两条烯丙基链中的一条缩短为甲基，因此只剩一个源自大蒜命名的烯丙基，而不是两个。
